business_summary: Nishio Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the construction machinery rental business in Japan and internationally. The company offers various construction machinery for special sites, expressways/railways/airports/harbors, industrial complexes and plants, and repair works, as well as equipment for events and exhibitions, such as tents, stages, monitors, temporary stands, etc.; and support from transporting to assembling/disassembling the equipment. It also leases construction equipment, industrial machinery, machines for factory equipment maintenance, lifting equipment, tools, tower cranes, mobile elevated work platforms, power generators, and survey instruments; provides transportation services, construction work support, consulting, community-based services, compulsory vehicle liability insurance, electrical engineering works, temporary electrical installations, parking lot management, and car rental services; and develops and rents wastewater treatment equipment and hardware. In addition, the company rents and sells shoring equipment, laser measurement devices, equipment for managing working environments in factories, devices supporting reduced energy usage, forklift trucks, and elevated work platforms; specialized vehicles, including battery electric and hybrid vehicles; designs and constructs hybrid trusses; and repairs and inspects crane trucks, specialized vehicles, forklift trucks, and other vehicles. The company was formerly known as Nishio Rent All Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nishio Holdings Co., Ltd. in April 2023. Nishio Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Nishio Holdings Co., Ltd.는 일본 및 해외에서 건설 기계 임대 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 특수현장, 고속도로/철도/공항/항만, 산업단지 및 플랜트, 수리공사 등 각종 건설기계와 텐트, 무대, 모니터, 임시 스탠드 등 행사 및 전시용 장비를 제공하는 회사입니다. 장비 운반부터 조립/해체까지 지원해드립니다. 또한 건설 장비, 산업 기계, 공장 장비 유지 관리용 기계, 리프팅 장비, 도구, 타워 크레인, 이동식 고가 작업 플랫폼, 발전기 및 측량 장비를 임대합니다. 운송 서비스, 건설 작업 지원, 컨설팅, 지역 사회 기반 서비스, 의무 차량 책임 보험, 전기 엔지니어링 작업, 임시 전기 설치, 주차장 관리 및 자동차 렌탈 서비스를 제공합니다. 폐수처리 장비 및 하드웨어를 개발 및 임대하고 있습니다. 그 밖에 쇼링 장비, 레이저 측정 장비, 공장 작업 환경 관리 장비, 에너지 절감 지원 장비, 지게차, 승강기 등을 임대 및 판매하고 있습니다.
